summary: Busy arterial beside the railway, with bus zones and no stopping signs.
reasons: Bus Zone and No Stopping signs
Main road, no parked cars on this side
No verge to pull off onto

drivers.seclusion: Rail corridor on this side; dwellings about 15 to 22 m across a busy road, with shops and a cinema beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is against the rail fence with no verge or parking lane; a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with queued traffic and trains; heavy noise.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone, No Stopping and 2-minute parking signs; cars do not park along this kerb.

flags: Bus Zone and No Stopping Any Time signs
Street edge is a through route into the station precinct
sun_shade: Open to sky; sun all day except a few trees near the south end.
